name: North Fork Flathead
gaugeName: N F Flathead nr Columbia Falls
blurb: Wild & Scenic water along the Glacier boundary. Logjams, gravel bars, and Polebridge pie.

sections.notes: Stop at the Mercantile before you launch. Wood is the hazard.
Steady Class II riffles. Glacier on river left.
Great Northern Flats is an optional pullout. Blankenship Bridge is the confluence takeout a few miles below Glacier Rim.
